window.title: Zhiyi IME Settings
app.name: Zhiyi IME
general.pinyin_style_hint: Full pinyin also accepts initials and mixes (wsyige); in initials mode each letter is one character
general.layout_hint: Learning mode translations show only in the vertical layout
general.english_correction_hint: Misspelled words get their correct spelling as a candidate; the first candidate stays what you typed
fuzzy.hint: Words with a similar sound are offered too, with their correct pinyin in parentheses, e.g. 中国(zhong guo)
keys.switch_hint: Tap Shift or Ctrl alone, or use a key combination
keys.style_hint: Chinese: full pinyin / initials    English: words / letters
keys.capture_hint: Click a key box, then press the new key (Esc cancels). Right-click clears it (no shortcut).
keys.need_combo: Needs Ctrl/Alt + key, Shift + Space or F1-F11
privacy.experience: Join the user experience improvement program
privacy.what: Logs basic information such as versions, settings and errors. Nothing you type.
privacy.input_what: Also logs what you type, the text before the caret, usage statistics and the program in use. Needs the user experience improvement program.
privacy.local: Records stay on this computer and are never uploaded.
privacy.input_confirm:
Zhiyi IME will log what you type, the text before the caret (the context the recommendation model reads) and the program in use on this computer, and join the user experience improvement program. The records are never uploaded.

The Privacy page links to the details. Allow it?
privacy.delete_confirm: Delete all records of the user experience improvement program (basic information and input)?
update.notify: Tell me when a new version is available
update.notify_hint: Checks GitHub for a new version when Settings opens. Only the version information is downloaded; nothing is sent.
update.not_found: No release information on GitHub yet.
update.network_failed: Could not reach GitHub. Check the network and try again.
update.invalid: The release information failed verification; the update was stopped.
update.download_failed: The download failed. Check the network and try again.
update.verify_failed: The installer failed verification and was deleted. Try again.
update.disk_failed: Could not save the installer: disk full or no permission.
update.install_cancelled: Installation cancelled. Click "Update now" to try again.
update.updated: Updated to {0}. Programs already open use the new version after they are reopened.
keys.note_taken: Used by another program, may not work
keys.note_program: May clash with common program shortcuts
keys.restore_confirm:
Restore the 4 switch keys to the defaults:

Chinese/English: tap Shift
Style switch: Ctrl + Space
Punctuation: Ctrl + .
Full/half width: Shift + Space

The current keys are replaced when you click OK or Apply. Continue?
keys.invalid: Use F1-F11, Shift + Space, or Ctrl/Alt (optionally with Shift) with a letter, digit, common punctuation key or Space; common shortcuts such as copy and paste are not allowed.
keys.conflict: The switch key is the same as the global "switch to Zhiyi IME" shortcut. Please choose another key.
dictionary.learning_hint: Words you pick often move up and new words are remembered; in English, the corrections you pick and the words you keep as typed
dictionary.clear_confirm:
Clear all learning data?

The learned candidate order and remembered words will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
dictionary.clear_failed: Could not clear the learning data. Make sure the IME is running and try again.
about.tagline: Lightweight, open-source, context-aware Chinese and English input method
learning.hint: The candidate window becomes vertical. Download a gray language's pack below first.
learning.failed_network: Can't reach GitHub. Check the network and try again
learning.failed_disk: Can't save the pack: not enough space or no permission
learning.not_found: This pack isn't on the server yet
learning.remove_confirm:
Remove the {0} language pack?

You can download it again later.
learning.remove_failed: Couldn't remove the pack while it's in use. Try again later.
error.save: The IME service could not save and apply the configuration.
error.hotkey_taken: The global shortcut is used by another program. The configuration was not saved.
